changeSet.author: ged
changeSet.comment: Usage des espaces (métier ou échange), hérité par les dossiers.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE ${database.defaultSchemaName}.noeud ADD CONSTRAINT ck_noeud_usage_espace CHECK (usage_espace IN ('METIER', 'ECHANGE'))
CREATE TRIGGER trg_noeud_chemin BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF parent_id, usage_espace ON ${database.defaultSchemaName}.noeud FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION ${database.defaultSchemaName}.noeud_chemin()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_noeud_chemin_enfants AFTER UPDATE OF chemin, usage_espace ON ${database.defaultSchemaName}.noeud FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION ${database.defaultSchemaName}.noeud_chemin_enfants()

rollback.sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_noeud_chemin BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF parent_id ON ${database.defaultSchemaName}.noeud FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION ${database.defaultSchemaName}.noeud_chemin()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_noeud_chemin_enfants AFTER UPDATE OF chemin ON ${database.defaultSchemaName}.noeud FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION ${database.defaultSchemaName}.noeud_chemin_enfants()
